title: Paul McCartney live: Allianz Parque, São Paulo | 2017
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Allianz Parque stadium in São Paulo, Brazil, on 15 October 2017.

Oi, Sir @PaulMcCartney! ?
A lenda já chegou cumprimentando a galera da Rua Palestra Italia ?? #PaulNoAllianzParque pic.twitter.com/bCK5xxll5c

— Allianz Parque (@AllianzParque) October 15, 2017

It was the 67th show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017. This concert was seen by 45,774 fans.

Before we get back to Belo Horizonte tonight here's another magical memory from São Paulo! ?? #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/fepjzpGooI

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 17, 2017

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

Lighting up São Paulo the other night ?? #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/DYztaeJVl5

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 17, 2017

McCartney had previously performed at the Allianz Parque stadium on 25 and 26 November 2014 during the Out There Tour. He returned on 26 and 27 March 2019 for the Freshen Up Tour, and 7, 9, and 10 December 2023, and 15 and 16 October 2024 for the Got Back Tour.
